title: Delegation worktree sweep: behavioural tests through real detach, shutdown and boot paths, plus refusal and junction cases
outcome: The worktree sweep's race and refusal guarantees are proven through the production paths that set them, not by editing private state.
acceptance: A test drives a real child runtime detach and its shutdown (cancel or finish) and shows the worktree fenced until that shutdown succeeds, and kept when it fails.
Tests cover the boot sweep request and the background coalescing of requests that arrive during a pass.
Tests cover refusal of an explicit worktree path under the repository's .git, in an unignored directory inside the repository, and through a symlink or junction that escapes it.
